units.source_text: 负责记录的少女反复地告诉名人：从白28到黑43封盘，共下了十六手。

en.t: The girl keeping the record told the Master again and again: from White 28 to the sealed move at Black 43, sixteen moves had been played in all.

units.source_text: 对手七段也说明是共下了十六手。

en.t: His opponent, the seventh-dan player, also explained that sixteen moves had been played altogether.

units.source_text: 开棋时，棋盘上只有四十二子，一目了然。

en.t: When play resumed, there were only forty-two stones on the board, which was plain at a glance.
Both of them told the Master,
but he still seemed unable to understand,

units.source_text: 把当天下的子，用指头一一地按住，

en.t: pressing each of the stones played that day with his finger one by one,
and slowly beginning to count them himself,
then, still seeming not to grasp it, he said:
